In the early 90’s I was attending college as “already a return student”. Computer Science/business as a focal point. There was not a Facebook or even a Google, believe it or not, at that time. Personal computers were only somewhat of a norm. My stepfather and I were still completely infatuated by the entire industry breakthrough. We kept up on all the latest buzz. We upgraded our operating systems together and with excitement waited for technology to rise. I laugh when I think about going to the computer store and buying a new program, coming home, loading it and absolutely expecting to wait three or four hours before we could utilize it. Now we are annoyed when we have to wait for updates before we can move forward. More him then me since I rarely even open my desk or laptop anymore. I have very little reason but to use my phone. Facebook has been a huge part of my lifestyle for many years. I have watched the growth, expansion, worldwide criticism and comeback several times. They have pulled through yet the difficulty in which seemed was over come in the early two thousands has not only increased but has completely disregarded its original purpose which was “the people”
Please Facebook do not turn into a faceless corporation and be what you were want to be. A means of connection for people and not just another means for isolating the few from the many. This may never be read but in the personal expression sat least one person feels better

Meta (FB/IG) App Developers
     
Report a Concern
by Change4Positive - Version 499.0.0 - Feb 11, 2025

To the Meta developers and software engineers of Instagram and Facebook: I have a suggestion for your applications account control center system. I recommend that a “select all” option be available in the followers and following lists, for the purpose of mass deletion of followers and those people follow. It would be much more convenient and time efficient to be able to “select all” and deselect those we want to keep and delete the rest that we no longer want on our followers/following lists. For example, I have spent hours manually deleting followers I no longer have an interest in them following me anymore and the same goes for those I once followed but no longer have an interest in following. This individual “unfollow” for each and every account is ridiculously tedious and extremely annoying. Some people have chosen to private their accounts due to issues such as internet gang stalking, online harassment and bullying, and other personal issues. Having a “select all” option would be extremely beneficial for the purpose of mass deletion of those who may have followed from unknown accounts or ghost accounts. Quite frankly, people’s taste changes over time and the repetitious negative behavior and negative energy would be much less likely of an issue for users that have had a high following count. I’m sure I’m not the only user that thinks this option would be highly beneficial. I’ll be emailing the company support directly to submit this idea as well.
